cases.purpose: Two processes submit in the same second across a consumer poll; the sequence persists and an ordinary at job is still consumed once.
cases.oracle: Submission and poll order are controlled by the observer; both submissions have the same observed second, the second sequence must increase, and the log and empty queue establish execution and removal.
cases.comparison: Record both IDs and run_at values, poll between submissions, then poll with a manually queued at job and poll again.
cases.stdout: across-poll same-second=yes sequence=increasing mixed-at=executed once=yes queue=empty
